note: Create each entry as a Retell custom function: POST to https://ai-healthcare-front-desk-api.halo-voice-parshva.workers.dev/webhooks/retell/custom-function, timeout 15 seconds, max retries 0, no extra headers or query parameters, and 'Payload: args only' turned OFF (the Worker needs the name, args, and call fields). The Worker verifies X-Retell-Signature with the server-side RETELL_API_KEY secret and only answers allowlisted test numbers (RETELL_TEST_NUMBERS). Business outcomes such as a taken slot come back as HTTP 200 with success=false and a message, because Retell does not show the agent the body of a non-2xx response. Write tools are idempotent per call: a repeated call with the same arguments returns the first result.

functions.name: get_availability
functions.description: Check fictional appointment openings for one clinic date. Use only after the caller picks a date and appointment type. Offer only the returned slots and read each one as its local_time. Never invent available times.

date.description: Local clinic date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timezone.description: IANA clinic timezone. Omit to use the clinic default, America/Chicago.

functions.name: create_appointment
functions.description: Book a fictional appointment only after the caller confirms one slot returned by get_availability. Use one of the sample names only. Say it is booked only if success is true, and give the returned DEMO reference.

start_at.description: The start_at value of the chosen slot from get_availability (UTC ISO-8601).

timezone.description: IANA clinic timezone used for get_availability. Omit for America/Chicago.

functions.name: lookup_appointment
functions.description: Read a fictional appointment after the caller gives its DEMO reference and sample name. Read back local_time, appointment type, location, and status. Use before rescheduling or cancelling.

functions.name: confirm_appointment
functions.description: Confirm a fictional appointment whose status is Needs confirmation, after matching its DEMO reference and sample name and getting the caller's agreement.

functions.name: reschedule_appointment
functions.description: Move a fictional appointment only after matching its sample reference and sample name, checking new availability, and receiving the caller's confirmation.

new_start_at.description: The start_at value of the chosen slot from get_availability (UTC ISO-8601).

timezone.description: IANA clinic timezone used for get_availability. Omit for America/Chicago.

functions.name: cancel_appointment
functions.description: Cancel a fictional appointment only after matching the sample reference and sample name, then confirming the cancellation with the caller.

functions.name: join_waitlist
functions.description: Add a fictional patient to the demo waitlist when no suitable time is available. Confirm the preferred date and sample name first. This creates a staff follow-up only; it does not book an appointment or send a text.

preferred_date.description: Preferred local clinic date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

timezone.description: IANA clinic timezone. Omit for America/Chicago.

functions.name: search_approved_faq
functions.description: Find an approved front-desk answer. Relay only the returned answer. If handoff is true, offer a staff follow-up using suggested_request_type. If emergency is true, tell the caller to contact their local emergency number now.

functions.name: request_staff_followup
functions.description: Create a minimal anonymous staff task for a callback, refill request, records request, billing question, document question, accessibility or interpreter request, or unanswered FAQ. Do not include the caller's free-text details.

functions.name: check_document_status
functions.description: Read the status of sample referral documents using a sample booking reference and sample patient name.
